newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN STOCKS SEEN MIXED ON SETTLEMENT DAY.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN STOCKS SEEN MIXED ON SETTLEMENT DAY.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Tuesday on profit-taking on the last clearing day, but dealers said select blue chips would rise on fresh buying towards the close.
"Sentiment will remain mixed on settlement day and the index could slip further on profit-taking," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "But select buying is expected towards the close."
The Karachi Electric Supply Corporation shares will rise on hopes of its early privatisation, he said.
On Monday, the index fell 11.75 points, or 0.58 percent, to 2,002.93. Losers led gainers 198 to 56.
Turnover fell to 62.39 million shares from 84.34 million in the previous session.
